profile.summary: A results-oriented IT specialist as both a Network Engineer and Systems Engineer. Proficient in the intricate management and operation of Unclassified, Classified, and Coalition networks,demonstrating a comprehensive grasp of these complex systems. Highly skilled in swiftly identifying and resolving network disruptions, ensuring seamless functionality. Equipped with the expertise to provide efficient configuration management, strategic planning, and seamless integration, thus elevating, sustaining, upgrading, and expanding network capabilities

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.locationName: Ramstein Air Base, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany · On-site
positions.description:
Leading a dynamic team of 6-8 members in ongoing network infrastructure projects and trouble tickets, providing training and guidance through quarterly rotations. 
Maintaining complex 3-tier Cisco networks made up of 1500+ network devices (Catalyst 9k, 3850, 2960x, Nexus, ISR, ASR). 
Proficiently manage classified network using 400+ General Dynamics TACLANEs via GemOne, employing redundant DMVPN tunnels for enhanced security and resilience. 
Monitoring security, network uptime, and disaster recovery via SolarWinds and Cisco DNA Center. 
Support organizations for network connectivity, i.e., SecureView, VDI, VTC, ACBN, BICES, BlackNet, and Wireless. 
Standardized network designs and architectures bringing L3 down into the distribution layer and reducing hop-count for end-devices through efficient and redundant data paths. 
Implemented and managed 600+ Aruba wireless access points providing unclassed AFNET connectivity.
Designed, planned, and upgraded Backbone Distribution Network (BDN). Replaced 21 Cisco 3800 series switch stacks with Cisco 9400 series chassis switches to increase processing load/uplink speeds and mitigate consistent stack failure. 
Designed, developed, and implemented new network transport solution for the classified network in expeditionary communication kits. 
Oversaw and executed year-long datacenter migration project, ensuring minimal disruption by coordinating ASIs with external organizations and managing the implementation of 100+ new fiber paths and relocation of critical network infrastructure.  
Designed/developed the comprehensive infrastructure topology for USAFE SIPR via Visio, ensuring a robust and strategically optimized network configuration. 
Efficiently managed the replacement of more than one hundred end-of-life 2900 series switches with 3800 and 9300 models, significantly enhancing network performance and reliability. 
Expertly oversaw the deployment and installation of NIPR and SIPR services for the USAFE/AFAFRICA Space Force HQ.
positions.insights: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Networking and +9 skills
